name: New push → Slack alert
description: Posts a one-line Slack alert whenever commits are pushed to your connected repo, naming the branch, pusher, and commit count. render_text turns the push event into the message string. To narrow it to a single branch, add a split_rows on row.ref before render_text and wire only its 'matched' port onward.

params.template: '🚀 ' + string(size(row.commits)) + ' commit(s) pushed to ' + row.ref + ' by ' + row.pusher.name
